about: The 40 new-scene prompts of ai/experiments/imagine (bench text25 + cases-new new15), for the chain classifier test (round3-plan §4.1).

cases.prompt: A ball rolls down a ramp.
Five dominoes in a row; tip the first one over so it knocks down the rest.
A toy car rolls down a ramp and onto the table.
Build a Rube Goldberg machine with at least four stages that ends with a ball dropping into a cup.
A marble rolls down two zig-zag ramps, knocks over a row of dominoes, and the last domino pushes a ball off a ledge into a bucket.
Stack four books on top of each other on the table.
Build a tower of six wooden blocks and knock it down with a swinging wrecking ball.
A phone slides down a cutting board propped up on two books and stops on a pillow.
Line up a soda can, a coffee mug, a candle and a water bottle on the table from tallest to shortest, left to right.
Balance a tennis ball on top of a standing soda can, which stands on a hardcover book.
A motorized toy car drives into three cereal boxes standing in a row and knocks them over.
A skateboard rolls down a long ramp and crashes into a traffic cone.
A pendulum with a 40 cm string swings down and knocks a golf ball off a wooden block.
Drop a heavy steel weight onto one end of a seesaw to launch a ping-pong ball from the other end into a basket.
Use a pulley with a heavier counterweight to lift a cup up off the table.
A conveyor belt carries three oranges and drops them into a basket at the end.
Drop a basketball onto a trampoline so it bounces up and lands in a bucket.
A spring launcher shoots a golf ball over a wall of three stacked bricks into a cup.
Drop a steel ball and a rubber ball together from 1 meter above the table.
Send a glass marble, a wooden ball and a rubber ball down the same ice ramp, one after another.
Something fun with balls.
Make a cool chain reaction.
A live cat knocks a glass of water off the table.
A waterfall pours into a bucket and turns a water wheel.
A 747 jumbo jet lands on a runway and taxis into a hangar.

superball bouncing down a flight of stairs
newtons cradle with 5 balls - pull one back and let it go

Use a lever to flip a coin into a cup.

A pendulum knocks over a line of dominoes, and the last domino bumps a toy car so it rolls away down a ramp.
desk chain reaction: a tennis ball rolls down a ruler propped on a book, knocks over a row of 6 dominoes, the last domino pushes a toy car, and the car crashes into a stack of plastic cups

kitchen table contraption with six steps: an orange rolls down a cutting board, hits a row of 5 dominoes, the last domino knocks a marble off a book, the marble rolls down a ruler, bumps a toy car, and the car rolls into a cereal box and knocks it over
make a mini golf hole where the ball goes down a ramp, over a little hill and into the cup
